reason: I can't buy anything without SSO, an audit log, and FIPS, and Loom's pitch doesn't mention any of them — a tool that shares my credentials across agents with no audit trail is a compliance non-starter, and Cursor/Copilot already share context inside the editor anyway.
objection: No SSO, audit log, or FIPS; I can't let a compliance team audit shared credentials they can't see.
would_change_my_mind: SSO, audit log, and FIPS support, plus a real security track record on GitHub and Reddit.
